:::: {.content-visible unless-format="revealjs"}
::: {.callout}
If your analytics page is newly created, skip to **Step c.**
:::

a. On **{{< fa square-poll-vertical >}} Analytics**, click on the tab for your custom page you'd like to add a visualization (widget) to.

a. Click **{{< fa pencil >}} Edit Dashboard**.

a. Select **{{< fa plus >}} Add Widget** then **{{< fa plus >}} Add Visualization**.

a. On the Add Visualization panel, enter your **Title**.

a. Select a **Visualization Type**:

    - **{{< fa chart-simple >}} Bar Chart**
    - **{{< fa chart-pie >}} Pie Chart**
    - **{{< fa hashtag >}} Counter**

a. Select a **Dataset**:

    - **Artifact^[[Working with artifacts](/guide/validation/working-with-artifacts.qmd)] - {Type}** — Logged artifacts scoped to only the specific artifact `{Type}`.^[[Manage artifact types](/guide/validation/manage-artifact-types.qmd)]
    - **Inventory Record - {Type}**^[[Working with the inventory](/guide/inventory/working-with-the-inventory.qmd)] — Logged records scoped to only the specific record `{Type}`.^[[Manage inventory record types](/guide/inventory/manage-inventory-record-types.qmd)]
    - **Inventory Record Stages Durations** — Days each inventory record has spent in each stage, across all inventory record types, with `Inventory Record Type` as a column so you can compare or filter by type.^[[Manage record stages](/guide/workflows/manage-record-stages.qmd)]
    - **Artifact Statuses Durations** — Days each artifact has spent in each status, across all artifact types, with `Artifact Type` as a column so you can compare or filter by type.^[[Manage artifact types](/guide/validation/manage-artifact-types.qmd)]
    - **Inventory Record - Dependencies** — One row per dependency between two inventory records, with the related record's ID and the dependency direction.^[[Configure record interdependencies](/guide/inventory/configure-record-interdependencies.qmd)]
    - **Inventory Segments - {Segment}** — Inventory records matching a published segment.^[[Manage inventory segments](/guide/inventory/manage-inventory-segments.qmd)]

    The two duration datasets return one row per record and stage, or per artifact and status, with a `Total Duration (Days)` measure you can average, sum, or take the minimum or maximum of. Time is counted in whole calendar days, the current stage or status is counted up to today, and repeat visits to the same stage or status are added together.^[Artifact status history is built from each artifact's activity log. Status changes made before per-field activity logging was introduced are counted toward the earliest status on record for that artifact.]

a. Select the visualization configuration options to apply to the dataset.^[[Visualization configuration options](/guide/reporting/manage-custom-reports.qmd#visualization-configuration-options)]

a. When you are done configuring your dataset, click **Add Visualization** to insert your custom widget onto the analytics page.

:::: {.content-hidden unless-format="revealjs"}
a. Select **{{< fa plus >}} Add Widget** then **{{< fa plus >}} Add Visualization**.

a. On the Add Visualization panel, enter your **Title**.

a. Select a **Visualization Type**:

    - **{{< fa chart-simple >}} Bar Chart**
    - **{{< fa chart-pie >}} Pie Chart**
    - **{{< fa hashtag >}} Counter**

a. Select a **Dataset**:

    - **[Artifact](/guide/validation/working-with-artifacts.qmd){target="_blank"} - {Type}** — Logged artifacts scoped to only the specific [artifact `{Type}`](/guide/validation/manage-artifact-types.qmd){target="_blank"}.
    - **[Inventory Record](/guide/inventory/working-with-the-inventory.qmd){target="_blank"} - {Type}** — Logged records scoped to only the specific [record `{Type}`](/guide/inventory/manage-inventory-record-types.qmd){target="_blank"}.
    - **Inventory Record Stages Durations** — Days each inventory record has spent in [each stage](/guide/workflows/manage-record-stages.qmd){target="_blank"}, across all inventory record types, with `Inventory Record Type` as a column so you can compare or filter by type.
    - **Artifact Statuses Durations** — Days each artifact has spent in each status, across all [artifact types](/guide/validation/manage-artifact-types.qmd){target="_blank"}, with `Artifact Type` as a column so you can compare or filter by type.
    - **[Inventory Record - Dependencies](/guide/inventory/configure-record-interdependencies.qmd){target="_blank"}** — One row per dependency between two inventory records, with the related record's ID and the dependency direction.
    - **[Inventory Segments](/guide/inventory/manage-inventory-segments.qmd){target="_blank"} - {Segment}** — Inventory records matching a published segment.

a. Select the [visualization configuration options](/guide/reporting/manage-custom-reports.qmd#visualization-configuration-options){target="_blank"} to apply to the dataset.

a. When you are done configuring your dataset, click **Add Visualization** to insert your custom widget onto the analytics page.
